AP Videos
AP Statistics FRQ 1 Walkthrough: Focusing on Practices 1 and 2In this video, we will break down the example Free-Response Question 1 by learning how to form valid investigative questions, analyze study design, identify sampling methods, and interpret data to draw valid conclusions.
AP Statistics FRQ 2 Walkthrough: Focusing on Practices 3 and 4In this video, we will break down the example Free-Response Question 2 by analyzing data and interpreting results through describing distributions and justifying conclusions with statistical evidence.
AP Statistics FRQ 3 Walkthrough: Focusing on InferenceIn this video, we will break down Free-Response Question 3 and explain how to conduct a hypothesis test, then evaluate how the process for constructing a confidence interval would change the required steps. Note: This video was updated to correct the confidence interval steps.
AP Statistics FRQ 4 Walkthrough: Focusing on Practices 2, 3, and 4In this video, we will break down the example Free-Response Question 4 by calculating probabilities and means, evaluating a claim, identifying the correct inference procedure, and interpreting a confidence interval.
More Resources
AP Statistics Course and Exam DescriptionThe CED outlines all required course content and skills and defines how they will be assessed on the AP exam.
